text.en:
On Weapon Kill:
37.5% Increased Charge Rate/Draw Speed for 6 seconds.

Kill while active add 4 seconds to the duration up to a maximum of 20 seconds.

enhanced (
#e Added time from additional kills is increased to 5 seconds.
)
text.zh-chs:
使用此武器造成最后一击时：
+37.5% 充能/拉弓速度，持续 6 秒。

增益触发时完成击杀，增加 4 秒持续时间，最高 20 秒。

enhanced (
#e 增益触发时完成击杀，增加的持续时间提升为 5 秒。
)

text.en:
On Weapon Kill, for 6 seconds:
37.5% Decreased Charge/Draw Time.

Kills while the perk active add #e${4+#d} seconds to the duration up to 20 seconds.

enhanced (
var d = 1
#e Additional kills add 1 more second to the duration.
)
